description: Recreation trail to alpine for winter snowmobile use and summer hiking.
directions: From Highway 16 in McBride turn south onto 1 Ave. Proceed 1.6km and turn right towards Sansom Road going under the bridge. Continue on Sansom Rd. for 2.1km and turn left onto the Lucille Forest Service Rd. The parking lot is 600m ahead on the right.
title: Lucille Snowmobile
